title: Illustrative onboarding shots for API/SDK auth, streaming, and tool-calling
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a comprehensive set of visual assets and annotated screenshots for the API/SDK quickstart docs focused on auth (API keys and token flow), streaming responses, and tool-calling flows. Deliverables should include: 1) high-fidelity Figma frames for hero quickstart steps (generate key -> configure SDK -> example stream), 2) a sequence diagram for tool-calling (client -> Redwood runtime -> tool/lambda -> callback), 3) annotated screenshots for console key rotation and permissions UI, 4) compact mobile-friendly illustrations for docs, and 5) export-ready assets (PNG/SVG) and a component library snippet for use in the docs site. Work should factor accessibility (color contrast, clear alt text), localization-ready text layers, and developer-focused clarity (show sample curl/JS/py snippets next to visuals). Coordinate with PM and Eng to lock final copy and telemetry links.
acceptance_criteria: Three annotated hero frames exported at 1440px and 720px with separate developer snippet callouts
Sequence diagram in SVG and PNG showing tool-calling lifecycle with error/fallback path
Console screenshots annotated and approved by PM and Eng with links to the real console flows
A single docs-ready ZIP containing PNG/SVG/optimized-web assets and a short README on filename conventions
Assets labeled and uploaded to Drive and linked from the doc PR, with all text layers editable for localization
